name: Buzzd
revenue_model: unknown (consumer app); pivot to business marketing tool
why_failed_hypothesis: Hypothesis: aggregating check-ins from Foursquare/Gowalla gave no unique data or habit in a crowded check-in market, so the consumer guide never gained traction and the team pivoted to selling to businesses.
notes: NYC-based real-time city guide/social network (cofounders Nihal Mehta and Deepen Shah). TechCrunch 2011-04-18: rebranded as Local Response; says Buzzd had about 1 million users and never gained traction; Local Response raised $1.5M in Dec 2010. 2009 BlackBerry app with real-time member ratings per 148apps. Only BlackBerry app verified; other platforms unknown. Unrelated 2025-26 iOS app also named Buzzd (college nightlife planner) exists. Extra: https://techcrunch.com/2008/04/24/buzzd-secures-series-a-funding/ ; https://apps.apple.com/us/app/buzzd/id6753351408

name: BarHopper
notes: Chose Barhopper, LLC iOS app (other similar names: BarHops, Barhopper's Guide, BarHoppin Ohio). Listing: live crowd counts from user check-ins, auto presence detection and check-out, see friends' check-ins; free. v2.4.1 dated 'Sep 25' with no year; year inferred as 2026 from version sequence (2.2.2 = 2025-11-24). v1.0 2024-08-08. No cities named; not enough ratings to display.

name: Google Maps (popular times / live busyness)
notes: Popular times and live busyness derived from aggregated, anonymized opt-in Location History; businesses cannot edit it; shown only with sufficient visit data (low-traffic bars may show none). Relative labels like 'Busier than usual' rather than explicit confidence. Android Authority 2026-08-13 reported popular times disappearing from Android app for some users (unclear if intentional). Crowd_sourced=partial (passive location, not reports). Extra: https://support.google.com/business/answer/6263531?hl=en ; https://androidauthority.com/google-maps-popular-times-2-3698496

name: Instagram (stories / location tags / Map)
notes: Location tags and Stories give informal real-time vibe; Instagram Map launched in US 2025-08-06 (opt-in, shares last active location with chosen friends; off by default). Sources disagree on whether it is truly real-time. No structured crowd/line data. Venue_tools via business accounts. Incentives=social status only.

name: Snap Map
notes: Place Loyalty badges launched 2026-04-22 (private top-visitor tiers). Promoted Places lets brands buy sponsored pins. Snap said 2026-07-22 that 65% of visits to new places are to places friends visited in the past year. Map shows friends' locations and public Snaps (heat) but no structured line/cover data. Snap also added in-app event planning 2026-09-10 (secondary reporting). Extra: https://ppc.land/snap-map-gains-15-million-users-as-friend-data-drives-65-of-new-visits/

name: TikTok (Local feed)
notes: US Local feed announced 2026-02-11 (Nearby elsewhere): surfaces events, restaurants and local businesses by precise location (opt-in, off by default, adults only); ranking uses location, relevance and recency. Content is recent but not live-status; no crowd/line fields. Creator fund/monetization exists generally (not verified for local posts).

name: Partiful
consumer_price: free; ticket fees on paid events (details unverified)
notes: Social invite/RSVP app; launched in-app Ticketing 2026-06-02 (iOS, Android, web; free/paid tiers, capacity, promo codes) per company press release. Group coordination for planned events, not live venue status. Competition: Apple Invites, Snapchat event planning (2026-09). Extra: https://smb.orangeleader.com/article/Partiful-Launches-Ticketing-Bringing-Paid-Events-Into-the-Social-Platform-Where-People-Already-Make-Plans/6a1f7d69004597ee6ba14b2d

name: Resy
revenue_model: SaaS fees from restaurants; owned by American Express (card-benefit driven)
notes: Amex Resy credits extended to select US Tock venues from 2026-09-15; credit-eligibility badge in app from 2026-08-01 (secondary blogs). Reservations integration inside Beli. Realtime=partial (table availability only, no crowd/vibe). Incentives=partial (card credits for diners, not reporting). Extra: https://blog.resy.com/newsroom/resy-launches-reservations-in-beli/

name: DICE
notes: Fever acquired DICE (announced 2025-06-05; terms undisclosed); reports say DICE had filed notice to appoint administrators days before (secondhand). Still operating as a brand; Music Week reports partnership extensions at first anniversary (date ~2026-06 inferred, not verified). Status=live but now a Fever subsidiary. Extra: https://news.pollstar.com/2025/06/05/ticketer-dice-acquired-by-events-discovery-platform-fever/ ; https://www.musicweek.com/live/read/dice-and-fever-mark-first-anniversary-of-joining-forces-with-series-of-partnership-extensions/094389

name: Posh
notes: NYC-based ticketing/event platform with nightlife roots; Fortune 2026-03-19: $37M Series B led by FirstMark, positioning as social discovery for 'what are we doing tonight'. CEO-reported ~8M users and 25M tickets (company figures, unverified). Total funding totals conflict across sources.

name: Eventbrite
notes: Bending Spoons agreed 2025-12-02 to acquire Eventbrite (~$500M all cash, $4.50/share), expected to close H1 2026; closing not confirmed in sources found. Platform itself still operating. Planned events, no live venue state.

name: Yelp
notes: Spring release 2026-04-21: redesigned AI Yelp Assistant, 35+ features, bookings/orders in chat. Fall release 2026-10-21: 30+ features incl. OpenTable reservations via Assistant (secondary coverage). Reviews are crowd-sourced but not real-time; Elite program as non-cash incentive. Extra: https://www.destinationcrm.com/Articles/ReadArticle.aspx?ArticleID=177129

name: Beli
notes: Social restaurant/bar ranking: users rank places relative to each other into personal 1-10 scores; see friends' lists; Resy reservations in-app. Not real-time. shows_confidence=partial (personalized match score; unverified detail). Boston Globe reported MAU ~1.1M as of mid-Oct 2025 (secondary snippet). Seed round reported by CB Insights (amount not independently verified). Extra: https://blog.resy.com/newsroom/resy-launches-reservations-in-beli/

name: Fever
notes: Live-experience discovery/ticketing; owns DICE (2025-06). Newsroom items 2026: OpenAI ChatGPT ad pilot (2026-02), Team Playmaker partnership (2026-04), NYC comedy-wine show debut at Arlo Williamsburg (announced 2026-05). Curated events, not bar live status.

name: Rally - Live Wait Times & Chat (Wait Watch)
notes: Closest direct competitor: wait times and crowd levels at bars/clubs/lounges/restaurants from 'owners & people at the venue in the last hour'; venues can claim pages (hours, photos, specials) but cannot override user reports; city leaderboard (incentive=partial). Latest v1.11 'Oct 17' no year shown; 2026 inferred from app id range (weak). Only 4 ratings. No city named.

name: LinePal
notes: iOS app (dev Jay Samir Shah): real-time bar wait times, estimated waits, trending bars, wait-time notifications. Data source not stated. Latest v2.7.5 2025-11-19; no ratings shown. Status=live only means listed in store; usage unknown.

name: Sense: Nightlife Statistics
notes: iOS app (dev Matthew Lee): live wait times, crowd size and gender ratios for bars/clubs. Data source and cities not stated. Last version 2.3.0 on 2023-03-28 and 8 ratings, suggesting dormancy; still listed. Status unknown (likely inactive).
